question: Can Sri Lanka–Thailand protected-area differences be explained by colonial rule versus non-colonisation?
mechanism: If colonial status were the decisive institutional transmission channel, formally independent Siam should lack comparable imported centralized conservation/forestry administration.
transmission_channel: British Indian/European forestry models and foreign expert administration reached Siam without formal colonisation
time_lag: late nineteenth-century forestry institutions precede later national-park legislation
bounded_by: Refutes the clean colonial/non-colonial causal binary only; it does not establish the causes of Thai national-park timing.
